boundary.description: From the junction of Victoria Road and Wellington Road, N along Wellington Road, Sherwood Street and by a straight line to Ladybarn Lane (excluding Ladybarn Road). Then S along Ladybarn Lane, Royle Street, Egerton Road, Paris Wood Road to its junction with Parkville Road. Then SW across Fog Lane Park to the end of Prince’s Avenue. S along Prince’s Avenue, Fog Lane, Lapwing Lane, Elm Road, Barlow Moor Road, Northern Grove, Burton Road, Aberton Road, Meltham Avenue, Whitchurch Road, Doncaster Avenue, Mauldeth Road West, Birchington Road and Victoria Road to its junction with Wellington Road.
